Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

Load data
```{r}
mega_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
```

Matrices with entropy and density values per patient
```{r}
### Entropy values
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy, R.NR, PFS, PFS_event) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

### Density values
df_density = mega_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

traitData = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(R.NR, PFS, PFS_event)

df_entropy = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(-R.NR, -PFS, -PFS_event)

write.csv(df_entropy, file = "../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv")
write.csv(df_density, file = "../input/MegaClusters_density.csv")
```

CD8 enrichment in megaclusters
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = Spatial_cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters",
       x = "Megaclusters",
       y = "Entropy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

CD8 enrichment per megacluster comparing response information
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Megaclusters density per megacluster comparing response
```{r}
ggplot(mega_clusters, aes(x = Cluster_type, y = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Megaclusters density by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Density"
  ) +

```

Extract groups
```{r}
hc = hclust(dist(scale(df_density)), method = "ward.D2")
k = 5
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)
plot(hc, main = "Patients groups", xlab = "", sub = "", cex = 0.8)
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = 2:4)

coldata = traitData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = clusters)
```

Remove groups with 1/2 patients
```{r}
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Groups %in% c(1,2,4))
# coldata = coldata %>%
#   dplyr::filter(Groups != 4)
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),]

#coldata$Groups = ifelse(coldata$Groups %in% c(4,2), 2, coldata$Groups)
```

PCA 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify) 
# Run PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(scale(df_density), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)  # already scaled

# Plot PCA
autoplot(pca_result, data = as.data.frame(df_density), 
         label = FALSE, 
         colour = coldata$Groups,
         size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA of df_density") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(features, survival.data, time_unit, p.value = 0.05) {
  library(survival)
  n_features <- ncol(features)
  significant_combinations <- list() # To store significant feature combinations

  # Create a formula dynamically based on the combination
  formula <- as.formula("Surv(time, status) ~ groups")
  
  # Prepare the data for survival analysis
  data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                               "status" = survival.data$PFS_event,
                               "response" = survival.data$R.NR) 
  
  data_for_model$coxHL <- paste0("Group_", survival.data$Groups)

  # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
  km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
  
  pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
  
  ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
  strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
  legend_labels <- strata_names
  legend.labs = legend_labels

  pdf("Results/SurvPlot_groups", width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                   data = data_for_model,
                   size = 1,
                   conf.int.style = "step",
                   pval = TRUE,
                   risk.table = TRUE,
                   risk.table.col = "strata",
                   legend.labs = legend.labs,
                   risk.table.height = 0.3,
                   ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                   title = paste0("Cox PH for Surv(time, status) ~ patient groups"),
                   xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
  ))
  dev.off()

}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(scale(df_density), coldata, "months", p.value = 1)
```
